_meta.description: The windowlicker stream (logs-dxdfir.windowlicker-*): the logs-*-* base + logs-dxdfir@settings + the GoDFIR Windows-artefact fields, plus the shared @winlog model its goevtx submodule normalises EVTX records onto. Priority 500 — higher than the logs-dxdfir.*-* fallback (200) — so this stream composes only this lane's model(s), not every lane's, and bare field names stay contained to the stream that uses them.
